Long pale tiles run toward bare benches set along the wall, and a single wall-mounted sign hangs above them on the tiled surface. No people stand on the platform; the space is clean and still, with muted gray and cream surfaces, soft daylight spreading across the floor, and clear architectural lines receding into the distance. The off-screen narrator begins the supplied line while quiet station ambience and a faint distant rail hum sit under the image. The composition stays wide and steady, keeping the empty platform and the sign in view.
Quiet station ambience and a faint distant rail hum fill the space.
The camera holds a static shot.

The shot cuts to the same station as a train pulls out from the platform. The carriages slide away along the track, wheels rolling and the rumble fading with the departure. The platform edge stays visible, empty except for the receding train and the station's tiled surface; no legible sign lettering is visible. The off-screen narrator's line finishes over the moving train, and the view remains wide and steady as the last carriage recedes into the distance.
Train wheels and carriage rumble rise as the train pulls out.
The rail rumble thins as the last carriage recedes.
The camera holds a static shot.
